observation: ZN-E004 (2-block head): MAPE 0.3266, Acc@15 0.355, RMSE 442.4, DB-MAPE 0.3266; DISCARD on RMSE (>437.8) and gradient gate (inter_mlp.0 55.08% near-zero late grads, same as with 9 blocks). 3 cells >1000 cycles give 86.65% of squared error.
primary_hypothesis: Removing the residual MLP stack (Linear(192->64) -> ReLU -> Linear(64->1)) eliminates the persistently dead inter_mlp.0 and passes the gradient gate while keeping ZN-E004 accuracy.
question_inherited: Is the inter_mlp stack needed at all after the masked summary?
unresolved_from_reference: Whether the dead first head block is removable without accuracy loss.
why_this_experiment: Last A2 follow-up of the ResConv family (Codex ZN-E004 analysis); architecture.md §2.3 lightweight head, §3 dead layers -> reduce depth. A further DISCARD closes the family (4 consecutive DISCARDs).
modification: Head only: inter_mlp 2 -> 0 blocks; summary Linear(192->64) -> ReLU -> Linear(64->1).
held_constant_components: Residual Conv1D curve encoder, masked summary, Linear(192->64), d_model 64, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py) vs ZN-E002; gradient health per block; EOL-band MAPE/bias; pred SD and corr; params/time.
rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs ZN-E004 MAPE 0.3266 / RMSE 442.4 / Acc@15 0.355 / DB-MAPE 0.3266). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3186 AND RMSE <= 452.4] OR [B: RMSE <= 421.4 AND MAPE <= 0.3296] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.375 AND MAPE <= 0.3296 AND RMSE <= 452.4], AND Acc@15 >= 0.325 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3366 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD.
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; ResConv stem/residual-block, inter_summary and head (inter_mlp) gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.mechanism: No residual MLP head (linear readout after summary projection)
architecture_addendum.evidence: inter_mlp.0 55% near-zero late gradients at both 9 and 2 blocks (ZN-E002, ZN-E004)
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> ReLU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: unchanged from ZN-E002: per-cycle encoding; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - cycle1
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE vs ZN-E004; gradient gate; EOL bands; pred SD/corr

smoke_evidence: Same variant/code path as ZN-E002/E004 Kaggle T4 runs; only mlp_layers changes (0 = empty ModuleList). Local forward: finite, padding-invariant.
